A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same XAutoLM study. The main text, equations, seven tables, ten figures, and Appendices A–D are accessible and can be matched across versions.

before.justification: V1 reports original classification and question-answering experiments in Tables 5–6, plus six-run single-objective experiments in Appendix C and Table 7.

after.justification: V2 retains the original benchmark experiments in Tables 5–6 and the repeated-run experiments and statistical analysis in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The AutoGOAL-based search, positive/negative experience updates, three utility schemes, and full/partial/LoRA fine-tuning options remain unchanged. Expanded hardware descriptions and proposed future evaluator backends do not establish an implemented method change.

E1.justification: Both evaluate LIAR, SST-2, MELD, and AG News classification, plus SQuAD 1.1 and DROP question answering. Larger-model and multimodal extensions remain future work.

E2.justification: Zero-shot AutoGOAL remains the comparator across all six benchmarks, with kNN-50 additionally evaluated for classification. The same warm-start variants and Appendix C comparisons are retained.

E3.justification: The objectives, cross-task experience exclusion, and 1.5/2-hour per-pipeline limits are retained. V1 already reports zero-shot results from the first 24 of 48 hours. V2 newly documents matching warm-start budgets, successful-only ET aggregation, and TV-bin selection without reporting a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The prior-bias comparisons, task-distance analysis, initialization plots, single-objective probes, and Pareto analyses are retained, including Appendices B–D. No new ablation, robustness test, or case study is introduced.

E5.justification: Both specify seed 42 for the main searches and six independent runs per configuration in Appendix C. Standard deviations, Shapiro–Wilk tests, ANOVA/Friedman tests, effect sizes, and significance discussions remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 4–7 retain identical entries, including experience counts, benchmark scores, runtimes, and appendix statistics. Figures 1–10 retain their plotted content. New prose describing failure-rate ranges summarizes results already present in the tables.

T1.justification: The experience definition, probability updates, similarity weighting, and utility formulations in Equations 1–9 are unchanged, as are Appendix A's mathematical specifications. Equation formatting changes introduce no new derivation or proof.

C1.justification: V1's contribution bullet claims up to 4.5-fold less search time; v2 describes mean pipeline evaluation-time gains and emphasizes equal-budget trade-offs. The unified-framework and five-of-six peak-F1 claims remain. The conclusion still loosely claims less search time.

C2.justification: V2 explicitly distinguishes pipeline runtime from total search compute. Its expanded scaling limitation separates the black-box optimizer from the single-GPU evaluator, discusses possible future backends, and limits claims to the evaluated setting. Existing statistical and energy-measurement limitations remain.

D1.justification: V2 adds operational detail about hardware profiles, TV-based prior selection, 24-hour warm-start/kNN budgets, and successful-only ET accounting. Appendix A.5 replaces the private anonymous-review access notice with a named GitHub repository reference. However, v1's explicit approximately 17B model-size cap is omitted.

R1.justification: V2 adds Nagel et al. on quantization, Dettmers et al. on QLoRA, and Zhao et al. on FSDP to motivate future scaling backends. The related-work comparison and central novelty positioning otherwise remain unchanged; these additions are not evaluated baselines.

P1.justification: V2 edits the introduction and contributions, expands the experimental explanation, adds a roadmap, organizes limitations under subheadings, and adds acknowledgments. Author/review text and wording are updated, while the main section sequence and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The author block is compacted, equation/table typography and captions receive small edits, and floats are repositioned. For example, Figure 9 now shares a page with Figure 8 rather than Table 7. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: V2 makes the retained evidence easier to interpret and reproduce by explaining the common evaluation budget, successful-only runtime metric, prior selection, and single-GPU applicability, while updating code-access information. These gains outweigh the reduced specificity from omitting the approximately 17B cap. The improvement is limited: experimental evidence is unchanged, and some loose search-time claims remain.
